title: The November 1981 HadISST1-to-OI v2 splice in AMIP SST forcing adds a pattern step (warm pool +0.08 K); in five Green's functions it makes 1979-2014 feedback 0.07 W m-2 K-1 more negative
abstract: Question: the PCMDI-AMIP SST forcing (AMIPII; versions 1.1.3 for CMIP6 and 1.1.9) is HadISST1 to October 1981 and NOAA OI SST v2 from November 1981. CMIP6 amip runs start in 1979 and amip-piForcing runs in 1870, so the splice is inside many feedback windows. Does the forcing change at the splice, and what does this change in Green's-function feedback estimates? Approach: we compared AMIP 1.1.9 with in situ products (ERSSTv5, COBE-SST2, HadSST4.2) on 60S-60N ice-free 5-degree boxes, 1950-2022. We fitted the step at 1981-11 (60 months each side, calendar-month and ENSO terms), scanned other dates, did a placebo test at 46 pseudo dates, removed the step, and applied five GFMIP Green's functions. Results: before the splice, AMIP is HadISST1 plus a fixed calendar-month offset per cell (temporal SD 0.003 K). The step has a near-zero 60S-60N mean (+0.009 K, -0.005 to +0.024) but a regional pattern: warm pool +0.082 K (+0.066 to +0.098; the largest break in a 1972-1992 scan, t = 4.7), southeast Pacific +0.08, east equatorial Pacific -0.07 and 40-60S -0.09 K. Its radiative effect beyond uniform warming (-0.058 W m-2) is rank 1 of 47 dates (placebo SD 0.017). Removal makes the 5-model feedback less negative: 1979-2014 by 0.070 W m-2 K-1 (0.009 to 0.132; 12 alternative corrections 0.023 to 0.116), 7% of the pattern term; 1979-2022 by 0.041; 1950-2014 by 0.18 (33%); 1870-2014 regression by 0.09, which is as large as the raw pattern term there (-0.01). With the ship-buoy adjustment, the 1979-2014 pattern term goes from -0.98 to -0.80. The step makes the 1979-2014 Pacific zonal gradient trend only 3-4% stronger, so it does not cause the trend-pattern problem. Limitations: linear 60S-60N Green's functions, not model runs; feedback per K of SST; references are sparse in situ products, and outside the warm pool the step is not the largest break and is reference-dependent; the cause (offset method or input change) is not separated.

display.caption: (a) 12-month running mean of AMIP 1.1.9 minus the in situ mean (ERSSTv5, COBE-SST2, HadSST4.2) for four regions; dashed line: the 1981-11 splice. (b) Single-step scan t-values (main fit) for AMIP 1.1.9 and HadISST1 in the warm pool and 30S-30N. (c) Smoothed splice step map (AMIP minus in situ mean, after minus before); boxes: warm pool, east equatorial Pacific and southeast Pacific regions. (d) Region steps with 95% bootstrap intervals and single-reference values.

(a) Radiative effect beyond uniform warming (Q_S, 5-model mean) of the step pattern fitted at 46 pseudo-splice dates (grey) and at the real 1981-11 splice (orange). (b) The same by model, with the placebo 95% range.

(a) Change of the Green's-function feedback (5-model mean) when the splice step is removed, for 30- and 36-year windows by first year; bands: bootstrap 95%; dotted: range of 12 alternative corrections. (b) 1979-2014 (CMIP6 amip window) change by model with bootstrap 95% intervals.
